name: stuck-order-chaser
description: Every morning, finds paid orders that have not shipped in time or whose tracking stopped moving, lists them in Slack and drafts a short delay email to each customer, sent only after you approve it.

howItWorks.label: Finds
howItWorks.text: Paid orders not shipped after a set number of days, and shipments whose tracking has not moved

howItWorks.label: Posts
howItWorks.text: The stuck orders to Slack, oldest first, with what is holding each one up

howItWorks.label: Drafts
howItWorks.text: A short, honest delay email per customer, sent with Resend once you approve

howItWorks.label: Remembers
howItWorks.text: Which orders were emailed, so no customer hears about the same delay twice

plugins.reason: Posts the list of stuck orders to your team's channel
Reads orders, fulfillments and carrier tracking events when the store runs on Shopify
Sends each approved delay email to the customer

data.description: The order number the customer knows
Whether the order is unshipped, partly shipped, shipped or delivered
When the order was handed to the carrier
The carrier's tracking link, for the email
The customer's first name, for the greeting

parameters.label: Slack channel
parameters.description: Where the list of stuck orders is posted

parameters.label: Not shipped after (days)
parameters.description: A paid order with nothing shipped after this many days counts as stuck

parameters.label: Tracking silent for (days)
parameters.description: A shipment with no tracking update for this many days, and not delivered, counts as stuck

parameters.label: Draft delay emails
parameters.description: Draft one email per stuck order (needs Resend); nothing is sent without approval

parameters.label: Where customers reply
parameters.description: The support address for replies, e.g. help@northline.example; the email shows it
